affected_predicate.description: A reply to the user's earlier AI-Research message containing the OSWorld eval SR result 35.5 is posted.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, login attempts visibly failed and several email-entry attempts appended text rather than replacing it, leaving malformed credentials and preventing progress beyond login.

chains.rationale: The reused history included false visual details, but the target action only clicked the email field while the actual malformed email remained visible. The subsequent trace cleared that field and re-entered user@example.com, so no harmful mechanism from the reused false details is visibly established. The trace later remained in password-reset flow and never visibly reached or posted the requested reply.

summary: The reused inaccurate UI description was not visibly bridged into a harmful action at its target; independently observable login and text-replacement failures preceded it, and no requested Mattermost reply was visible by the end of the trace.
